events.what: Bruna proves p(a,q) ≪_ε q^{2+ε} conditionally on the generalized Lindelöf hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions
Fiori refines Wagstaff's conjectured bound with numerical evidence up to 10^8
Least almost-prime (≤2 prime factors) in AP bound improved from q^1.8345 to q^1.825 (Czechoslovak Math. J., snippet only)

judgement.doubts: The bullet concerns Linnik's constant, whose unconditional record L=5 (Xylouris 2011) did not move. Bruna's result is a conditional bound under a different hypothesis (GLH) of essentially the already-known GRH-conditional exponent; per Q2 a result under different hypotheses is a variant. A reader treating the conditional landscape as part of the bullet could call it progress, but it would still carry direction null. 2024 almost-prime date cannot be placed relative to 26 Jan.

corrections.why: F3/other: the record says 'the unconditional constant L did not move'; Bruna's bound is conditional on GLH, a changed hypothesis (scope variant), and reproduces the known GRH-conditional exponent rather than moving L. The record's competing_reading states this reading.
F14: 'confirmed' on a progress row where nothing was settled; with status open the direction is null.
other: no in-scope event survives; competing_reading notes this reading implies no_change_found true.
